_about: Reviewed decisions the source registry applies (tools/build_source_registry.py). `strings`: a claim source string, verbatim, read as naming a registry source (`to`, with a locator), a new source named only by the string (`new`), or `unresolved`. A decision that merges two different strings into one source (`to`, or `new` with `merge`) is applied only with `review.verdict` accept. `nodeUrls`: a document or legislation node's own URLs that are the document itself (reviewed). `tierAdjudications`: Tier 1 claims whose every source is an interested party, with why Tier 1 stands.

c-1786f3dd2c.why: Reports what the released AARO memorandum concludes, quoting it: a record of the office's own statement, which the interested-party rule leaves at Tier 1.
